Messages.Author: Trebbs
Messages.Body:
Hi to all,
I have played V:TeS with a Rush deck and a Bleed/Unblockable deck and
now i would play with a political deck, but i have a question about
the use of political action.
A card that require a Prince or a Justicar can even be played by a
Inner Circle Member?
And, if i play a political card and no one casts a vote, the
referendum passes?
If someone can answer to my questions, i would be greateful
Thanks in advice

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Trebbs wrote:
>
> Hi to all,
> I have played V:TeS with a Rush deck and a Bleed/Unblockable deck and
> now i would play with a political deck, but i have a question about
> the use of political action.
> A card that require a Prince or a Justicar can even be played by a
> Inner Circle Member?

No. The vampire playing the card must meet the requirements of playing
the card.

> And, if i play a political card and no one casts a vote, the
> referendum passes?

No. A tied referendum (even one tied at zero to zero) fails.

However, if you cast the vote you get from the political card
and you cast that vote in favor of the referendum, then the
referendum will pass 1-0 if no other votes are cast.
